en.headline: This week: half brown rice
body: Try half brown rice, half white rice this week.
Brown rice keeps your sugar steadier after meals.
en.passage: Start by mixing half brown and half white rice

ms.headline: Minggu ini: separuh nasi perang
body: Cuba separuh nasi perang, separuh nasi putih minggu ini.
Nasi perang membantu gula anda lebih stabil selepas makan.
ms.passage: Start by mixing half brown and half white rice

zh.headline: 这周：一半糙米
body: 这周试试一半糙米、一半白米。
糙米让饭后血糖更稳定。
zh.passage: Start by mixing half brown and half white rice
